actions.name: list_calls
actions.description:
Retrieve call data by date range (/v2/calls). List calls that took place during a specified date range.

When accessed through a Bearer token authorization method, this endpoint requires the scope 'api:calls:read:basic'.

cursor.description: When paging is needed, provide the value supplied by the previous API call to bring the following page of records.

fromDateTime.description: Date and time (in ISO-8601 format: '2018-02-18T02:30:00-07:00' or '2018-02-18T08:00:00Z', where Z stands for UTC) from which to list recorded calls. Returns calls that started on or after the specified date and time. If not provided, list starts with earliest call. For web-conference calls recorded by Gong, the date denotes its scheduled time, otherwise, it denotes its actual start time.

toDateTime.description: Date and time (in ISO-8601 format: '2018-02-18T02:30:00-07:00' or '2018-02-18T08:00:00Z', where Z stands for UTC) until which to list recorded calls. Returns calls that started up to but excluding specified date and time. If not provided, list ends with most recent call. For web-conference calls recorded by Gong, the date denotes its scheduled time, otherwise, it denotes its actual start time.

workspaceId.description: Optional Workspace identifier, if supplied the API will return only the calls belonging to this workspace.

actions.description:
Add new call (/v2/calls). When using this endpoint, either provide a downloadMediaUrl or use the returned callId in a follow-up request to /v2/calls/{id}/media to upload the media file.

When accessed through a Bearer token authorization method, this endpoint requires the scope 'api:calls:create'.

clientUniqueId.description: A call's unique identifier in the PBX or the recording system. Gong uses this identifier to prevent repeated attempts to upload the same recording.

title.description: The title of the call. This title is available in the Gong system for indexing and search.

purpose.description: The purpose of the call. This optional field is a free text of up to 255 characters.

scheduledStart.description: The date and time the call was scheduled to begin in the ISO-8601 format (e.g., '2018-02-18T02:30:00-07:00' or '2018-02-18T08:00:00Z', where Z stands for UTC);

scheduledEnd.description: The date and time the call was scheduled to end in the ISO-8601 format (e.g., '2018-02-18T02:30:00-07:00' or '2018-02-18T08:00:00Z', where Z stands for UTC);

actualStart.description: The actual date and time when the call started in the ISO-8601 format (e.g., '2018-02-18T02:30:00-07:00' or '2018-02-18T08:00:00Z', where Z stands for UTC);

duration.description: The actual call duration in seconds.

parties.description: A list of the call's participants. A party must be provided for the primaryUser.

items.description: A list of the call's participants. A party must be provided for the primaryUser.

phoneNumber.description: The phone number of the party, if available.

emailAddress.description: The email address of the party, if available.

name.description: The name of the party, if available.

customData.description: Optional metadata associated with the call (represented as text). Gong stores this metadata and it can be used for troubleshooting.

speechSegments.description: The audio recording speech segments (who spoke when).

items.description: The audio recording speech segments (who spoke when).

actions.name: list_calls_extensive
actions.description:
Retrieve detailed call data by various filters (/v2/calls/extensive). Lists detailed call data for calls that took place during a specified date range, have specified call IDs or hosted by specified users.

When accessed through a Bearer token authorization method, this endpoint requires the scope 'api:calls:read:extensive'. 
Moreover, clients requesting media download URLs by the contentSelector.exposedFields.media field should also have the scope 'api:calls:read:media-url'.

cursor.description: When paging is needed, provide the value supplied by the previous API call to bring the following page of records.

fromDateTime.description: Date and time (in ISO-8601 format: '2018-02-18T02:30:00-07:00' or '2018-02-18T08:00:00Z', where Z stands for UTC) from which to list recorded calls. Returns calls that started on or after the specified date and time. If not provided, list starts with earliest call. The date applies to call start time.

toDateTime.description: Date and time (in ISO-8601 format: '2018-02-18T02:30:00-07:00' or '2018-02-18T08:00:00Z', where Z stands for UTC) until which to list recorded calls. workspaceId.description: Optional Workspace identifier, if supplied the API will return only the calls belonging to this workspace.

callIds.description: List of calls Ids to be filtered. If not supplied, returns all calls between fromDateTime and toDateTime.

primaryUserIds.description: An optional list of user identifiers, if supplied the API will return only the calls hosted by the specified users. The identifiers in this field match the primaryUserId field of the calls.

contentSelector.description: The content selector identifies which data components, if any, are needed, by the caller

context.description: If 'Basic', add links to external systems (context objects) such as CRM, Telephony System, Case Management. If 'Extended' include also data (context fields) for these links. Default value 'None'

contextTiming.description: Timing for the context data. The field is optional and can contain either "Now" or "TimeOfCall" or both. The default value is ["Now"]. Can be provided only when the context field is set to 'Extended'

items.description: Timing for the context data. The field is optional and can contain either "Now" or "TimeOfCall" or both. The default value is ["Now"]. Can be provided only when the context field is set to 'Extended'

exposedFields.description: The exposed fields identifies which field, if any, are returned in the response object

parties.description: If true, add information about the parties of the call

structure.description: If true, add call agenda, if available

topics.description: If true, add duration of call topics

trackers.description: If true, returns smart tracker and keyword tracker information for the call.

trackerOccurrences.description: If true, the API will return the timing and speaker ID of each occurrence of a tracker (in addition to other tracker data). This functionality must be used in combination with the "trackers" field. The occurrence data is available only for the calls recorded since Jan 1, 2023, contact Gong support if a backfill of this data is required.

trackerSummary.description: If true, the API will return an LLM-generated summary for each smart tracker hit on the call (in addition to other tracker data). This functionality must be used in combination with the "trackers" field. Not available for keyword trackers.

trackerEvidence.description: If true, the API will return the scored evidence segments (start/end time, score, speaker ID) behind each smart tracker hit on the call (in addition to other tracker data). This functionality must be used in combination with the "trackers" field. Not available for keyword trackers.

brief.description: When true, returns the spotlight call brief.

outline.description: When true, returns the call outline.

highlights.description: When true, returns the call highlights.

callOutcome.description: When true, returns the outcome of the call.

keyPoints.description: When true, returns the key points of the call.

interaction.description: The interaction data of the call

speakers.description: If true, add the time each participant spoke.

personInteractionStats.description: If true, add statistics for the host of the call.

publicComments.description: If true, add public comments made for this call

media.description: If true and exist, add audio url and video url of the call. The urls will be available for 8 hours.

actions.description:
Ask about an entity (/v2/entities/ask-entity). Returns the answer to a question about a specified entity. The answer is generated from calls or emails associated with the entity within the specified time period. A maximum of 60 calls and 500 emails are used to answer the question. A call to this API consumes Gong credits according to the number of emails and calls used to generate the answer. Supported entities are Accounts, Deals, Contacts, or Leads that exist in your CRM. The response includes:
  • The answer
  • Details of emails and calls used to generate the answer
Required authorization scope: 'api:ai-ask:read'. Get AI-generated answers to natural language q...

timePeriod.description: Specifies the time period during which associated calls and emails must have occurred to be used to generate the answer. The calls and emails must be associated with the specified entity.

fromDateTime.description:

actions.name: find_phone_number_references
actions.description:
Retrieve all references to a phone number. (/v2/data-privacy/data-for-phone-number). Shows the elements in the Gong system that reference the given phone number. Given a phone number, this endpoint returns details of any leads or contacts with this phone number and their associated calls and email messages.

When accessed through a Bearer token authorization method, this endpoint requires the scope 'api:data-privacy:read'.

phoneNumber.description:
The phone number.

This number must start with a + (plus) sign followed by the country code, area code, and local phone number. All other non-digits are ignored.

The following are examples of permitted phone numbers: +1 425 555 2671, +1-425-555-2671, +1 425 5552671, +14255552671, +1 425 555 26 71, +1(425) 555-2671, etc.

Note: This parameter should be URL-encoded.

actions.name: find_email_address_references

Given an emails address, this endpoint returns details of all calls and email messages that reference this address, and any leads or contacts with this email address.

When accessed through a Bearer token authorization method, this endpoint requires the scope 'api:data-privacy:read'.
